findings.body: The runner now properly checks for a valid git identity via `required_execution_source_identity` and fails closed (raising `SourceIdentityUnprovenError`) prior to generating any canonical evidence if identity is 'UNKNOWN' or non-plausible.
findings.title: Strict Git SHA Source Identity Verification

findings.body: Ensures that run execution strictly resolves to a non-zero exit code if the status is not `RUN_STATUS_OK`, matching semantic statuses reliably.
findings.title: Terminal Status Exit Code

findings.body: In `integrate_batch_results_with_webhook_detailed`, batch insertion errors fallback to a fail-closed error mode when no idempotency evidence exists, rather than silently classifying it as an idempotent duplicate.
findings.title: Batch Retriever Fail-Closed on Unverified Idempotency

remaining_risks: Run environments without a valid git binary or a `.git` directory will now hard-fail when attempting to generate canonical execution evidence. This is strictly correct per the new invariant but requires operators to ensure they run from a valid git checkout.
summary: Audited RTE v5 terminal provenance fail-closed PR (#1232). The code properly implements fail-closed invariants for terminal statuses, missing git source identity, and batch webhook idempotency verification. All required tests pass (verified deterministic, side-effect free, and properly mocked), and there are no secret leaks or scope creeps.
